intro_q: You walk through Riverside Park most evenings and have recently noticed a safety issue affecting the area after dark. You decide to contact Marcus, the local council's parks and public spaces officer, to report your concern.
bullet1_q: Describe the lighting problem you have observed in the park.
bullet2_q: Explain why this issue poses a risk to park users.
bullet3_q: Suggest a practical measure the council could take to improve the situation.
